text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, when I go to check the track

conditions...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear metallic clanging coming from
somewhere... I look in the direction of
the sound and see
Mihono Bourbon
running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Test concluded. All conditions within
acceptable parameters. Load increase
confirmed to be safe.
Optimal weight
calculated at...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she stands there after her run, I
glance at her feet and see what look to
be extremely heavy
weights tied around
her ankles.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
These are custom-made ankle weights
meant to
increase resistance during
training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The weights pose no issue. Based on my
previous
assessments, doubling this load
will still fall within
an acceptable range.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to calculate the most
optimal mass
limit for me. Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch Mihono Bourbon as she runs off
with ease,
despite having adding more
weights to her
ankles.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Concern acknowledged. Auditory
disturbances from nocturnal practice
sessions could negatively
impact the
surrounding area.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My sincere apologies. I was unaware of
the noise
issues. Thank you for bringing
this information to
my attention.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, I shall take appropriate
measures, such as adjusting my practice
hours, to ensure I
do not disturb others
during training.
